Unsupported URL scheme (gopher) is rejected

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
begin
  engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
  url = 'gopher://invalid.example.com/'
  result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
